intro.fr: Factorio Platformer se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Factorio Platformer can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub lepideble/factorio-apworld, qui héberge l'APWorld de Factorio Platformer.
text.en: The GitHub repository lepideble/factorio-apworld, home of the Factorio Platformer APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, platformer-0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, platformer-0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version platformer-0.4.6, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (12 versions publiées).
text.en: Version platformer-0.4.6 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (12 versions released).

text.fr: Factorio Platformer figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Factorio Platformer is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
